page: Amazon Web Services m6gd.12xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor and custom 64-bit ARM architecture. The system provides 48 dedicated physical cores running AWS Graviton Neoverse-N1 processors clocked at 2.5 GHz, with one thread per core. Memory allocation stands at 192.0 GB of RAM, preserving a standard 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The processor features 64 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache, alongside hardware acceleration for AES encryption.

Local storage comprises a bundled 2850 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, delivering high-speed direct-attached operational capacity without auxiliary network storage overhead. Networking throughput is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The instance contains zero discrete GPUs, relying exclusively on CPU execution for compute and analytical tasks.

Benchmark analysis indicates strong multi-core throughput, with stress-ng multi-core testing placing in the top 25 percent. Conversely, single-threaded processing exhibits lower relative performance, with Geekbench single-core and single-threaded gzip compression rating in the bottom 25 percent. Memory bandwidth delivers steady uncached performance of 168.57 GB/sec for reads and 80.07 GB/sec for writes. Workloads requiring sustained multi-threaded compute alongside local low-latency disk access, such as relational databases, Redis caching layers, static web serving clusters, and batch processing, align well with this resource profile.
description: Amazon Web Services m6gd.12xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 48 dedicated physical cores on AWS Graviton Neoverse-N1 ARM64 processors running at 2.5 GHz. The configuration supplies 192.0 GB of system memory, matching a balanced 4.0 GB per core allocation, alongside 2850 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD instance storage and a 20 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark results reveal strong multi-core scaling, reaching the top 25 percent in stress-ng multi-core benchmarks, counterbalanced by lower single-threaded performance in Geekbench and data compression evaluations. Database operations, memory throughput, and static web serving register in the mid-tier performance distribution, while text generation and large model inference show constrained efficiency. Operating on the Nitro architecture without discrete GPUs, m6gd.12xlarge is structured for multi-threaded enterprise services, distributed database systems, in-memory caching platforms, and data processing pipelines demanding rapid local NVMe storage.
